description:
How much the forecast can be trusted at this point, hour by hour, from
    ensemble spread — Solano's own indicator, not a raw model output.

    Each deterministic model is compared against the members of ITS OWN
    reference ensemble (GFS→GEFS, ECMWF IFS→ECMWF-ENS, ICON→ICON-EPS), never
    against a mixed pool: the systematic offset between forecasting centres
    would otherwise be charged to the model as if it were uncertainty.

    The percentage blends wind (60%), rain intensity class (25%) and pressure
    (15%). High means the scenarios converge, so the forecast is solid; low
    means they diverge and the forecast should be treated as uncertain.

    Use this when asked "is this forecast reliable?", "will it hold?", or before
    committing to a passage plan. Returned per day: mean and minimum confidence,
    plus the per-variable breakdown at the least confident hour.
name: get_confidence
title: Model agreement
